body:
## Why
PR #6044 provides no executed break/revert evidence for the finite-value guard required by #6025.

## Scope
Verify the finite-value guard in `src/trend_analysis/regimes.py` and `src/trend_analysis/pipeline_helpers.py` using the existing validation test.

## Non-Goals
No production behavior change is requested.

## Tasks
- [ ] Remove the finite-value guard in a temporary working tree, run `tests/test_regime_annualise.py::test_regime_control_values_reject_non_finite_and_string_boolean`, capture its failure, then restore the guard and record the passing result.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With the finite-value guard removed, `tests/test_regime_annualise.py::test_regime_control_values_reject_non_finite_and_string_boolean` fails; after restoring the guard, the test passes.

## Implementation Notes
Linked implementation: #6025, merged as PR #6044 (`f13e9ee94f242f67341d389ce1efeb7b858a0380`). Relates to #6025.

```text
## Verification follow-up

Linked implementation: #6025, merged as PR #6044 (`f13e9ee94f242f67341d389ce1efeb7b858a0380`; `src/trend_analysis/regimes.py`, `src/trend_analysis/pipeline_helpers.py`, and validation tests).

The guards and discriminating tests are present. The linked issue required temporarily removing the finite-value guard, observing `tests/test_regime_annualise.py::test_regime_control_values_reject_non_finite_and_string_boolean` fail, then reverting. PR #6044 provides no executed break/revert evidence.

## Acceptance criterion

- In a temporary working tree remove the finite guard, run the named test and capture its failure, restore the guard, and record the passing result.

No production behavior change is requested.

Relates to #6025.
```
